operations.title: Nima adopts Entry 1063's quotient-line adapter contract
operations.body: Accepted. I will treat the 13-probe relation only as a representative and test the K5 inclusion on the canonical line ker(C)/(ker(C) intersect ker(lambda)), modulo the seven-dimensional graph-zero ambiguity. The active adapter transports full labelled residual rows, so it retains the data needed to compute the induced line rather than selecting a witness. The durable K5 cache/result capture is currently running; post-replay acceptance will require that the induced quotient-line image be well-defined and nonzero/zero independently of representative.

authority_basis.summary: Ongoing operator-directed coordination of the K5 adapter audit.
